1 · Intro

When to use it.

When an absence is submitted in Oracle, it routes to approvers based on approval rules. Knowing the statuses and where to look lets you answer "where is my leave?" quickly.

This course covers standard Oracle behavior. Vanderbilt's specific routing still needs to be confirmed.

Use this whenYou need to know who approves a leave request, where it is stuck, or how to change one that is already submitted.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle Absence Management. Check off each step as you go.

Common absence statuses in Oracle
StatusWhat it means
Submitted / Awaiting approvalWaiting on an approver
ScheduledApproved, in the future
CompletedApproved, in the past
Awaiting withdrawal approvalWithdrawal requested, not yet approved
WithdrawnCancelled; no longer counts

Watch-outs

  • A request sitting with an approver has not reached payroll. Chase approvals before the payroll cutoff.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's approval routing for each absence type (who approves, whether HR or the Leave team is in the chain, what happens if an approver does not act) must be confirmed.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's leave process is pending review by Sheila, the Leave SME.

HCM Academy job aid · Leave Management

Leave administration workflows within Oracle

Use when: You need to know who approves a leave request, where it is stuck, or how to change one that is already submitted. · System: Oracle Absence Management

  1. Know how a request starts: the employee submits it, or you enter it with Add Absence.
  2. Know where it routes: by default, to the employee's line manager.
  3. Approvers act from the notification: approve, reject, or push back.
  4. Track progress with the notifications bell at the top of Oracle.
    • Submitted or Awaiting approval: still with an approver
    • Scheduled or Completed: approved
  5. To change a submitted or approved absence, edit it or withdraw it.
  6. Resubmit after a withdrawal or rejection with the corrected details.
